canonicalDecision: cpf-common is a mandatory default dependency.
changes: Existing cpf-starter now exposes cpf-common by default; persistence providers remain separately selectable.
No new Logging Starter or top-level product was created.
Visible cpf.logging map binding validates application-owned file policies.
Internal Logback adapter adds runtime/error/extensible daily appenders without removing Console output.
Common maintenance runs immediately and on a bounded daemon schedule with success/failure progress logs.
Runtime files are separated by application and instance.
backendContract: Default Logback is implemented; an alternate SLF4J backend can explicitly disable CPF file wiring and supply its own backend policy.
next: Compile/test the default Starter and real multi-file output before Generator modification.
